errors.evidence: The first chart shows industry as 61% (19.0 million), not 8% (2.4 million).
The first chart shows construction as 8% (2.4 million), not 19% (5.9 million).
The first chart shows trade as 19% (5.9 million), not 12% (3.7 million).
The first chart shows other services as 12% (3.7 million), not 61% (19.0 million).
The second chart shows industry as 51% (80.2 million), not 21% (6.6 million).
The second chart shows construction as 9% (13.4 million), not 19% (5.9 million).
The second chart shows trade as 19% (29.5 million), not 31% (9.8 million).
The second chart shows other services as 21% (33.0 million), not 51% (16.0 million).
The value 6.6 million is incorrect; the reference shows no such value, and the correct value for other services in the second chart is 33.0 million.
